question: Where is the patient add form implemented in the frontend?
answer: The patient add form UI is implemented in the React component `AddPatientComponent.jsx` under `frontend/src/PatientComponents/`. It contains the JSX form and submits via `PatientService` to the backend API.
contexts: frontend/src/PatientComponents/AddPatientComponent.jsx: React component with form fields and handleSubmit that calls PatientService.createPatient(...)
frontend/src/services/PatientService.js: exports createPatient(data) which calls ApiService.post('/api/patients', data)
frontend/src/App.js: includes routing to the route that renders AddPatientComponent
ground_truth: AddPatientComponent.jsx (frontend/src/PatientComponents/) implements the add-patient form and uses PatientService to send data to the backend.
